text.lead: P.O.V: Norowareta Film (Japanese: ＰＯＶ～呪われたフィルム～, Hepburn: P.O.V. Noowareta Firumu) (also known as P.O.V.: A Cursed Film) is a 2012 Japanese found footage horror film directed by Norio Tsuruta.
text.plot: During a TV segment about ghost videos, television presenters experience a supernatural incident in a TV studio while one ghost video rolls. They trace the origins of the ghost video to a junior high school where they enter with camcorders to investigate the source of supernatural occurrences.
text.cast:
- Haruna Kawaguchi
- Mirai Shida
- Yasuyuki Hirano
- Takashi Kodama
- Mayu Miura
- Ami Shimazaki
- Yuki Shinshita
- Yasuto Kosuda
